title: docs(pm-dispatch): the claim template carries the `Premise:` line the pre-dispatch premise check writes
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DMMchS2pMx7VafJmdzGaxFv)_

Fixes #25663

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读(草稿)

- **改了什么**:认领模板(`SKILL.md` 〈模板与表〉)在 `Thread-read:` 之后加一行 `Premise:`,即 #25552 规定的派发前前提核实读数;棘轮上限 318 → 319。
- **为什么改**:runbook 要求读数落认领 `Premise:` 行,模板却没有,照模板抄就会漏。
- **风险与代价(含回滚)**:一行模板文字 + 一个上限数字;一次 revert 可回。
- **你要做的(一个动作)**:无。上限按您的裁决 6385407063(「同意 318→319」)抬;复核通过、CI 全绿由席位按 Tier S 落地。

## What changed

- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` 〈模板与表〉, after `Thread-read:`: `Premise: holds | corrected <comment id> | inbox (the pre-dispatch premise reading, dispatch-runbook.md 派发前置)` (116 bytes). The three values are `dispatch-runbook.md` 〈派发前置〉's three outcomes: 成立 ⇒ 派, 改法明确 ⇒ 改卡再派, 判不了 ⇒ 入决策箱.
- `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`: the `SKILL.md` row 318 → 319, its comment citing ruling 6385407063. `SKILL.md` is not a `CROSS_FILE_MOVES` destination, so no `ruledRaises` record applies.

## Gates

On this head: `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` ✓ (319 / 319), `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint` ✓, `pnpm check:skill-frame-sync` ✓, `pnpm check:skill-frame-freshness` ✓, `pnpm check:pm-governed-prose` ✓; self-tests of the claim readers ✓ (`post-stamped.mjs`, `check-half-states.mjs`, `check-expected-skips.mjs`, `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs`, `check-dispatch-gates.mjs`); `check-commit-card-trailers.mjs` ✓. No claim parser keys on `Premise:` yet, so the line is inert to them. No package moves: `skip-changeset`.

## Acceptance notes

- Carrier of the deferral in PR #25658 (card #25490); ruling recorded on #25663 as 6385407063.
- Governed surface `.claude/**` (Tier S); opened through the fleet-write relay `pr_create`; every later write goes through the relay too.
